_comment: Tier -> tool value tables. No real model name belongs anywhere else under .act/ -- only here, plus a project's own fixed-model override in docs/ai/config.md § Roles. 'reasoning_scale' is the ladder a role's reasoning field, and a '-high' variant's one-step bump, walk; 'reasoning_field' is the tool's own frontmatter key for it (Claude Code: 'effort'). A tool with an empty 'tiers' object has no researched mapping yet -- .act/scripts/tiers.py then leaves a role's existing model/effort untouched instead of guessing one.

codex-cli._status: research stage, not confirmed -- verify against config.toml [profiles.<name>] / model_reasoning_effort before filling in

copilot-cli._status: research stage, not confirmed -- verify reasoningEffort frontmatter support (issue #2904) before filling in

gemini-cli._status: research stand, experimental subagent model field -- verify model IDs live (consumer vs. API naming differs) before filling in

cursor._status: no per-role model/reasoning field today -- manual choice in the UI only

aider._status: no per-role concept -- --model/--reasoning-effort apply to the whole run, not a single role

cline._status: no confirmed per-role model/reasoning field -- dashboard shows reasoning effort as part of the model config
